|descr= Describes a game terrain.

|param1= name
|descr1= Terrain name

|param2= wbLink
|descr2= {{Link|Arma Reforger:World Editor}} link to the terrain

|param3= image
|descr3= (Optional) image

|param4= defaultDateTime
|descr4= (Optional) terrain's default date and time

|param5= season
|descr5= (Optional) terrain's current season

|param6= landArea
|descr6= (Optional) land area surface

|param7= totalArea
|descr7= (Optional) total area surface

|param8= minMaxAltitude
|descr8= min and max altitude

|param9= coords
|descr9= (Optional) in-game geographic coordinates

|param10= dimensions
|descr10= (Optional) in-game dimensions (e.g 4096x4096m)

|param11= resolution
|descr11= (Optional) terrain resolution (e.g 2m for a 2x2m cell)

|param12= basedOn
|descr12= (Optional) real-life location on which it is based
<!--

-->

|result1= {{Infobox/Terrain}}

|result2= {{Infobox/Terrain|name= Nogova}}
